name: KbWen/agentic-os
summary: Governance-first workflow framework for Codex and other coding agents, using Work Log-backed phase gates, burden-of-proof reviews, spec-drift checks, and evidence requirements to keep completion claims backed by verifiable implementation evidence.
evidence: Ships Codex-specific installer guidance, Codex agent definitions, Codex safety rules, and `/codex-cli` workflow support while keeping Codex a first-class target inside a broader cross-agent framework.
The review workflow starts acceptance criteria and behavioral claims as unproven, then requires concrete code, test, or output evidence before allowing them to pass.

Uses Work Log state, gate receipts, Diff Base SHA, spec-drift checks, classification-aware phase gates, and ship checklists to connect delivered artifacts back to requirements, risks, and verification evidence.
